title: Social Media Content Planning for REALTORS
description: A fun Q&A session around sharing how Sandee Payne, REALTOR® and Teal Lead for Designed 2 Sell Real Estate Group and her Social Media Creator structure and plan their social media content calendar and execute it for Real Estate. Presented as a Q&A webinar on ZOOM. Get started with ideas and step that you can put into action right away to build you social media library.
